english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something typical or representative of a person or thing.
Use 典型 when classic means a representative or textbook example of a type.
Use this when something is a characteristic or textbook example of its type.

examples.english: This is the most characteristic style of a Hong Kong cha chaan teng.
examples.traditional: 呢個係最典型嘅香港茶餐廳風格。
